New ecosystem moves open conversations across procurement and finance buyers, usually more accounts in-market than the B2B team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Corcentric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Raman, quick follow-up for Corcentric.

New partnerships widen the opportunity set, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your B2B team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Corcentric's reply rate likely compares to peer procurement-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
